intro: Victoria Chikalkina performs as a soloist and chamber musician on modern piano, fortepiano, and harpsichord.
Classical piano remains central to her career. She graduated with honors in 2023 from the Tchaikovsky State Conservatory in Moscow, in the class of Professor Maxim Philippov.

That same year she received the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship (ESKAS) for advanced piano studies at the Geneva University of Music (Haute École de Musique de Genève) with Paul Coker and Fabrizio Chiovetta, and with Pierre Goy for clavichord and historical keyboards.

She has also taken masterclasses with Rena Shereshevskaya, Alexander Kobrin, Laurent Cabasso, Ricardo Castro, Jean-Claude Vanden-Eynden, Elena Kuznetsova, Vera Nosina, Eduardo Delgado, and François Dumont.

items: Rachmaninoff Days in Moscow — First Prize (in both Piano and Chamber Ensemble categories, 2015)
Lavaux Classic Piano Competition — Third Prize (Cully, 2024)

sections.title: Concert Career
paragraphs: Since 2021, Victoria has been a soloist with the Ryazan Regional Philharmonic. She maintains an active solo and chamber music concert career, performing regularly on international stages.

She appears at major European musical events and festivals, including the Sobrio Festival, the Fête de la Musique in Geneva and Neuchâtel (Franz Liszt Hall and Temple du Bas), and the Festival de L’Ensemble L’Encyclopédie at the Zubov Foundation-Museum in Geneva (Fondation-Musée Zubov). She has performed at the Embassies of Switzerland and Iceland in Moscow.
